title: Per-App VPN app mapping
description: Assigns Mac apps to a per-app VPN by bundle ID and code requirement.

AppLayerVPNMapping.title: app layer VPN mapping
AppLayerVPNMapping.description: The array of VPN mapping dictionaries.

DesignatedRequirement.title: Designated requirement
DesignatedRequirement.description: The code signature designated requirement of the app using the per-app VPN.

Identifier.title: Identifier
Identifier.description: The bundle identifier of the app using the per-app VPN.

MatchTools.title: Match tools
MatchTools.description:
An array of dictionaries. Each dictionary specifies a per-app VPN rule. Use this property to restrict this per-app VPN rule to only match the app's spawned _helper tool_ network traffic.

For example, to match network traffic that the curl command generates when run from the Terminal.app, create an app mapping payload for Terminal.app and set the payload's MatchTools key to an array that contains a dictionary that matches the curl command-line tool.

DesignatedRequirement.title: Designated requirement
DesignatedRequirement.description: The code signature designated requirement of the command-line tool using the per-app VPN.

Path.title: Path
Path.description: The file-system path of the command-line tool using the per-app VPN.

SigningIdentifier.title: Signing identifier
SigningIdentifier.description: The code signature signing identifier of the command-line tool using the per-app VPN.

Path.title: Path
Path.description: The file-system path of the executable using the per-app VPN.

SigningIdentifier.title: Signing identifier
SigningIdentifier.description: The code signature signing identifier of the app using the per-app VPN.

VPNUUID.title: VPNUUID
VPNUUID.description: The identifier of the per-app VPN payload, which defines the per-app VPN that the app uses. See the VPNUUID key of the AppLayerVPN payload.
